docs.text: Classes The following classes have been reviewed and approved for this campaign. Class Description Primary Ability Source Alchemist A caster class with explosive, transformative, or restorative capabilities Dexterity, Intelligence Artificer A caster class that uses inguinity and magic to unlock extrodinary capabilities in objects. Constituion, Intelligence Barbarian A Martial tank class who are powered by primal forces manifesting as Rage Strength, Constitution Bard A caster class using inspiring performances with Dance, Music and Magic. Dexterity, Intelligence Beastheart A martial class that forms, and draws streangthh from, a bond of friendship with a wild creature Strength, Wisdom Blood Hunter A martial class sacrificing vitality for esoteric damage. Dexterity, Intelligence Captain A martial class that has control over a secondary character Warlord A martial support class that directs ally positioning. Strength, Charisma Mage Hand Press Cleric SRD Review the Sidekick & Cohort Classes if you are managing a retainer.
